design.text: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, parallel-group, placebo-controlled trial; subjects randomized 1:1:1:1 to tirzepatide 5, 10, or 15 mg or placebo SC QW over a 40-week treatment period.

citations.quote: A multicenter, randomized, double-blind, parallel-group, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial in subjects with T2D
This trial consisted of 3 periods: a 3-week screening/lead-in period, followed by a 40-
week treatment period, and a 4-week safety follow-up period. Subjects were randomized in a 1:1:1:1 ratio (tirzepatide 5, 10, or 15 mg, or injectable placebo SC QW).

population.text: Adults with type 2 diabetes, naive to antihyperglycemic injectable therapy, inadequately controlled with diet and exercise alone and not treated with any oral antihyperglycemic medication during the three months preceding trial start.

result.text: HbA1c change at Week 40: placebo -0.09%, tirzepatide 5 mg -1.75%, 10 mg -1.71%, 15 mg -1.69%. FDA-analyzed difference from placebo: 5 mg -1.64 (95% CI -1.94, -1.34); 10 mg -1.60 (95% CI -1.90, -1.30); 15 mg -1.59 (95% CI -1.90, -1.28); all p<0.001. HbA1c <7% achieved by 81.8%, 84.5%, 78.3% of the 5/10/15 mg arms vs 23.0% placebo (p<0.001).

indication.text: MOUNJARO is indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus.

target_moa.text: Tirzepatide is a glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) receptor and glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist; it selectively binds to and activates both the GIP and GLP-1 receptors, the targets for native GIP and GLP-1. It is the first-in-class agent to activate both incretin receptor types.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (>=5%): nausea, diarrhea, decreased appetite, vomiting, constipation, dyspepsia, and abdominal pain. In placebo-controlled trials nausea occurred in 12%/15%/18% (5/10/15 mg) vs 4% placebo, and diarrhea in 12%/13%/17% vs 9% placebo. GI adverse reactions led to discontinuation in 3.0% (5 mg), 5.4% (10 mg), and 6.6% (15 mg) of patients.

detail.text: WARNING: RISK OF THYROID C-CELL TUMORS. Tirzepatide causes thyroid C-cell tumors in rats; it is unknown whether MOUNJARO causes thyroid C-cell tumors, including medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC), in humans. MOUNJARO is contraindicated in patients with a personal or family history of MTC or in patients with Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).

citations.quote: ## WARNING: RISK OF THYROID C-CELL TUMORS

- Trizepatide causes thyroid C-cell tumors in rats. It is unknown whether MOUNJARO causes thyroid C-cell tumors, including medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC), in humans as the human relevance of trizepatide-induced rodent thyroid C-cell tumors has not been determined (5.1, 13.1).
MOUNJARO is contraindicated in patients with a personal or family history of MTC or in patients with MEN 2.
